data.summary: This six‑week plan tackles the weak Fluid unit first, then cycles through the remaining units, ending with a mixed review. Each week uses the full four hours, with concrete tasks and a single live class in week 3 that covers key Fluid topics.

tasks: Read textbook section on 8.1 and 8.2, then solve 5 problems on density and pressure. Mark solutions using the rubric.
Watch lecture video on 8.3, then complete 3 free‑response questions on fluid forces. Review 8.4 by summarizing conservation principles in 200 words.
Attend live class 10400. Take notes on key equations. After class, redo 2 practice problems from the class handout and compare answers with peers.
Solve 4 kinematics problems involving vectors. Then tackle 3 Newton’s Second Law problems, marking each solution.
Timed 30‑minute quiz covering one problem from each listed topic. Review mistakes and rewrite solutions.
Take a full-length 60‑minute practice exam. Score yourself, then analyze errors and create a one‑page summary of key concepts to remember.

data.final_week_advice: In the last week, focus on consolidating your understanding, practicing under timed conditions, and identifying any lingering weak spots before the exam.
